title: Vaja 16 — the peak and the count of three, as the workbook marks them

fromTheBook: the mucus symbol for each of cycle days 5..18
the V marking the peak on day 15
provenance.howVerified: The 'Sluz (v kraticah)' row was aligned against the 'Dan cikla' row at two magnifications, correcting for the page skew. Both alignments put V over the last of five consecutive S+ days and 1, 2, 3 over the three vl days that follow.
provenance.notTranscribed: The temperature row, the Obcutek/Videz rows, the Motnje entries and the 'plodni dnevi' row are all filled in on the page but are not transcribed here: the sheet is photographed at an angle across a curve in the page and their columns were not verified to the standard above. See sensiplan-rule-capture task 2.3.

expected.notes: The peak is the LAST day at the best quality reached, not the first: days 11-15 are all S+, and the V is on 15. It becomes identifiable only on day 16, when the quality drops to vl. The count of three runs over calendar days, not over days of any particular category.
